latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 4K CapCut Video Editor.

- Edit raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and export as 4K MP4 files using CapCut-style tools.
- Cloud backend processes uploads and editing in 1–2 minutes; supports content creators and YouTubers.
- Automatic session and token management with free credits for new users.
- Supports video trimming, transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and batch editing.
- Simple instruction mapping: upload, preview timeline, edit, and export workflows.
- Clear status, error reporting, and tips for best results included.
